data_fields.name: drainPerSec
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 unit per logic tick (health_old steps toward health_current)

data_fields.name: maxHp
data_fields.donor_constant: modeldata.health per entity (data, value not read)

best_idea: A lagging ghost health fill that drains from the old value toward the server value at a fixed rate, with each overflow segment in its own colour tier.
decision_why: Client-only view, so the one ledger and server-verified kills are untouched; the donor's per-tick drain and pixel-width-coupled segments are replaced by an HP-per-second data field and exact segment edges.
acceptance: After a 30-HP hit the number drops at once to the server value and the ghost fill drains over about 0.3 s at 100 HP per second; a 201-HP enemy shows the third-segment colour at 201; a server test asserts the ghost value never changes health.
